تبتاعون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَاعُونَ (tabtāʕūna) /tab.taː.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
# تُبْتَاعُونَ (tubtāʕūna) /tub.taː.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
